title: Standalone HTML cannot start
gameplay_impact: Standalone HTML cannot start
reproduction: Extract the shipped HTML script and parse it with vm.Script.
expected: The delivered file contains executable game code.
actual: Invalid or unexpected token; cargo messages contain inserted HTML.
root_cause: String.replace interprets dollar-sign substitution tokens inside the replacement source.
fix: Use literal replacement callbacks and validate the script extracted from the final HTML.
regression_tests: Actual standalone browser launch, mission win, purchase and reload
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Standalone theme is corrupted
gameplay_impact: Standalone theme is corrupted
reproduction: Launch the embedded edition after stripping the Google Fonts import.
expected: The root theme variables and local fallback fonts survive packaging.
actual: White page, dark text on dark scenery, missing button colors.
root_cause: The import-removal regex stops at a semicolon inside the font URL and leaves invalid text before :root.
fix: Remove the complete import line and test the embedded CSS prefix.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Side contact teleports the UFO onto a roof
gameplay_impact: Side contact teleports the UFO onto a roof
reproduction: Fly right from x743,y530 toward the first barn.
expected: Stop at the side and retain altitude.
actual: Y changes instantly from 530 to 469.
root_cause: Every horizontal building overlap is resolved as a roof collision.
fix: Resolve the earliest swept AABB contact and slide along its normal.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Airborne cargo crosses building sides
gameplay_impact: Airborne cargo crosses building sides
reproduction: Launch a rock horizontally toward a building at 600, 12000 and 60000 units/second.
expected: Solid walls stop or deflect cargo.
actual: The rock crosses the wall because only roof crossings are handled.
root_cause: Airborne integration has no side/underside collision resolution.
fix: Sweep every airborne body against solids and world boundaries; resolve contact velocities.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Released people pass through roofs
gameplay_impact: Released people pass through roofs
reproduction: Drop a defender above a building, then destroy its support.
expected: Land and recover on the roof; fall after support is removed.
actual: The defender reaches ground inside the building.
root_cause: Building contact handling exists only for carried cargo.
fix: Share airborne contact handling across characters and cargo; validate support before grounded/stunned behavior.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Suspended cargo penetrates floor and stage edges
gameplay_impact: Suspended cargo penetrates floor and stage edges
reproduction: Hold a rock while hovering at y540 near the left boundary.
expected: The rock remains above ground and within the stage.
actual: The rock bottom reaches y649 below the y610 floor.
root_cause: Beam followers directly update positions without geometry or bounds.
fix: Move lifted bodies through the same bounded collision solver and report blocked cargo.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Distant cover shields a nearer UFO
gameplay_impact: Distant cover shields a nearer UFO
reproduction: Fire a stress-speed shot through a UFO with a building farther along the same segment.
expected: The nearer UFO is hit first.
actual: The building consumes the shot before the UFO is considered.
root_cause: Collision loops are ordered by object category rather than time of impact.
fix: Select the earliest hit among buildings, cargo and the moving ship.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Shots miss hits when a step ends outside the map
gameplay_impact: Shots miss hits when a step ends outside the map
reproduction: A fast shot crosses the UFO and finishes beyond the stage in one step.
expected: Resolve the crossing before removing the projectile.
actual: No damage is dealt.
root_cause: Out-of-bounds cleanup runs before swept collision checks.
fix: Resolve the valid lifetime segment, then expire or remove the projectile.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Fast dropped cargo tunnels through a defender
gameplay_impact: Fast dropped cargo tunnels through a defender
reproduction: Drop a stress-speed rock through a defender in one step.
expected: A cargo impact defeats the defender once.
actual: The defender survives because endpoint boxes no longer overlap.
root_cause: Cargo damage uses only discrete final positions.
fix: Sweep the actual cargo shape over its traveled path before applying impact damage.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: A boss-stage defender spawns embedded in a building
gameplay_impact: A boss-stage defender spawns embedded in a building
reproduction: Create mission 5 with seed 1234, or iterate the first ten seeds.
expected: Non-sheltered actors spawn outside solid rectangles.
actual: A thrower at approximately x1293.93 overlaps the x1280 building.
root_cause: Spawn placement does not validate collider extents.
fix: Choose the nearest free horizontal spawn position; share depenetration for stale overlaps.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Lifted objects cut through solid scenery
gameplay_impact: Lifted objects cut through solid scenery
reproduction: Hold a rock left of a building while the ship is on its right.
expected: Cargo remains on the near side or slides around the geometry.
actual: The rock moves through the building.
root_cause: Lifted movement bypasses collision entirely.
fix: Apply continuous collision to beam following without disabling the beam or solids.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: A shelter target disables unrelated wall collisions
gameplay_impact: A shelter target disables unrelated wall collisions
reproduction: Assign a civilian a shelter beyond an intervening building.
expected: Reject the unreachable route and retain collision.
actual: The civilian walks through the intervening building.
root_cause: A truthy shelterId bypasses all building checks.
fix: Validate a reachable entrance; enter shelter as an explicit protected state at the doorway.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Transports drive through solid buildings
gameplay_impact: Transports drive through solid buildings
reproduction: Drive a delivery truck toward a blocked drop-off.
expected: Stop before the obstruction, unload safely, and return by a valid direction.
actual: The truck crosses the building.
root_cause: Scripted truck positions are integrated without collision.
fix: Sweep the route, stop and unload at a blockage, and reverse departure direction when necessary.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Doorway shelter needs protection and occupant feedback
gameplay_impact: Doorway shelter needs protection and occupant feedback
reproduction: Enter shelter at its new safe doorway position and activate the beam above it.
expected: Sheltered occupants are protected and counted until exit or destruction.
actual: Without an explicit exclusion, the doorway occupant remains beam eligible; the renderer has no occupancy data.
root_cause: Shelter protection previously depended on physical overlap with the building.
fix: Exclude sheltered targets from capture/impact decisions, count occupancy, hide the sheltered actor, and restore behavior on exit.
limitations: This defect was found during integration of the collision-safe shelter correction.

title: Agents repeat a blocked last-sighting move
gameplay_impact: Agents repeat a blocked last-sighting move
reproduction: Give an agent a remembered target beyond a wall after sight is lost.
expected: Abandon the blocked intent briefly and make progress away from the wall.
actual: Cached target steering repeatedly overrides the collision reversal.
root_cause: There is no failed-route cooldown or memory invalidation on contact.
fix: Clear blocked target memory and apply a bounded navigation cooldown before reconsidering it.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Older code overwrites future-version progress
gameplay_impact: Older code overwrites future-version progress
reproduction: Store version 2 with a version 1 backup, load, then change a preference.
expected: Retain the newer record and report that the old client cannot save it.
actual: persistSave returns true and replaces the newer schema.
root_cause: Version rejection is implemented only in the loader.
fix: Refuse writes over unsupported primary schemas and preserve unsupported backup records.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Half-step multipliers lose rewards and records
gameplay_impact: Half-step multipliers lose rewards and records
reproduction: Complete a run with maxCombo 1.5, save and reload.
expected: Keep 1.5 and award a 75-credit performance bonus.
actual: The record becomes 1 and the bonus is 50.
root_cause: A general integer normalizer is used for fractional multipliers.
fix: Validate half-step multipliers separately while retaining existing integer saves.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Burst effects lack a voice cap and explicit graph cleanup
gameplay_impact: Burst effects lack a voice cap and explicit graph cleanup
reproduction: Trigger 100 effects at the audio boundary and finish the sources.
expected: Bound simultaneous voices and release oscillator/gain connections.
actual: 100 oscillators are created with no ended cleanup callbacks.
root_cause: Every effect constructs nodes without a cap or disconnect lifecycle.
fix: Cap effects at 16 voices, disconnect ended nodes, and provide explicit disposal.
limitations: The 100-event burst is a stress fixture. No browser audio-heap leak or speaker clipping measurement is claimed.

title: Victory notes outlive the scene that scheduled them
gameplay_impact: Victory notes outlive the scene that scheduled them
reproduction: Schedule victory audio, mute and re-enable immediately, then run pending callbacks.
expected: Old scene notes are canceled.
actual: All four delayed notes still play.
root_cause: JavaScript timers are not owned or canceled by scene transitions.
fix: Schedule notes on the audio clock and cancel all transient voices at scene, pause and mute boundaries.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Rejected browser audio resume becomes unhandled
gameplay_impact: Rejected browser audio resume becomes unhandled
reproduction: Make AudioContext.resume reject.
expected: Report the failure once and continue gameplay.
actual: The resume rejection is unhandled.
root_cause: A synchronous try/catch cannot catch a rejected resume promise.
fix: Handle resume/close promise rejection and report unavailable audio.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Beam source creation failure can terminate a frame
gameplay_impact: Beam source creation failure can terminate a frame
reproduction: Make oscillator creation throw after context initialization.
expected: Optional audio failure is reported without stopping the game.
actual: The beam path throws to the main frame loop.
root_cause: Unlike tone creation, beam graph construction has no error boundary.
fix: Catch and report beam graph failure, release partial state, and preserve gameplay.
limitations: Fault injection passes; physically disconnecting an output device was not tested.

title: Escape fails in a settings select and nested menus resume unexpectedly
gameplay_impact: Escape fails in a settings select and nested menus resume unexpectedly
reproduction: Open settings, focus the difficulty select, and press Escape; repeat from pause.
expected: Escape closes the dialog and nested settings return to pause.
actual: The early input-element return ignores Escape; closing nested settings resumes play.
root_cause: Keyboard routing checks form targets before modal commands and has no modal parent.
fix: Route modal commands first, track the pause parent, and restore game focus on resume.
regression_tests: Actual browser select/Escape and nested pause/settings
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Modal focus can escape to unrelated page controls
gameplay_impact: Modal focus can escape to unrelated page controls
reproduction: Open settings and Shift-Tab from its first control.
expected: Focus wraps inside the dialog.
actual: Focus reaches controls outside the dialog.
root_cause: Only part of the interface is inert and there is no keyboard focus trap.
fix: Isolate all background sections, wrap Tab focus, and restore a valid focus target.
regression_tests: Actual browser Shift-Tab wraps to All set
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Right click activates the beam and unrelated releases interrupt it
gameplay_impact: Right click activates the beam and unrelated releases interrupt it
reproduction: Right-click the canvas, or release another finger while a mouse beam is held.
expected: Only the owning primary pointer controls that beam.
actual: Right-click starts it; any pointer release stops it.
root_cause: Pointer state has no button filter, ownership, or lost-capture handling.
fix: Track each input owner, filter primary clicks, and handle cancel/lost capture.
limitations: Mouse/keyboard browser checks and synthetic pointer regression pass; physical multi-touch hardware was not available.

title: A held joystick finger can resume stale movement
gameplay_impact: A held joystick finger can resume stale movement
reproduction: Hold the stick, pause/resume, and move the old pointer without a new press.
expected: Reset ownership and require a new press.
actual: The old pointer changes movement after resume.
root_cause: Reset clears axes but leaves the captured pointer ID valid.
fix: Clear IDs, release owned capture, and ignore stale/secondary pointers.
limitations: Synthetic multi-pointer lifecycle passes; physical touch hardware was not tested.

title: Display backing size, camera and pointer coordinates can diverge
gameplay_impact: Display backing size, camera and pointer coordinates can diverge
reproduction: Resize to an extreme aspect ratio or a high-DPI viewport.
expected: Use bounded logical world dimensions, a clear backing buffer, and drawable-area hit testing.
actual: An ultrawide fixture allocates width 7200 and the camera uses different limits; backing resolution ignores display scale.
root_cause: Canvas backing pixels are used as world coordinates and are derived from the unconstrained window ratio.
fix: Separate logical viewport, CSS drawable area and bounded backing resolution; map pointers through the actual canvas rectangle.
limitations: Actual native fullscreen transition and physical high-DPI hardware were not confirmed in the in-app browser.

title: Actors keep animating while gameplay is paused
gameplay_impact: Actors keep animating while gameplay is paused
reproduction: Pause after a moving character or effect is visible.
expected: Gameplay animation pauses with simulation time.
actual: The renderer continues using the wall clock.
root_cause: Rendering uses requestAnimationFrame timestamp rather than simulation time.
fix: Render active gameplay from game.time; retain ambient menu timing.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Phone title actions are clipped and header credits wrap
gameplay_impact: Phone title actions are clipped and header credits wrap
reproduction: Use the title at 320x640.
expected: The main action is visible and credits remain readable.
actual: The short game panel clips the action and squeezes the balance onto two lines.
root_cause: The phone canvas aspect ratio is too short for title content, and header content can shrink/wrap.
fix: Give narrow phones a taller game frame, allow scrollable menus, contain balance text, and improve HUD labels.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Missing Canvas or an unexpected render exception leaves no recovery UI
gameplay_impact: Missing Canvas or an unexpected render exception leaves no recovery UI
reproduction: Return null from getContext, or throw during a frame.
expected: Display a recovery action, preserve banked data, and retain the diagnostic.
actual: A blank or frozen game is left without recovery guidance.
root_cause: No explicit startup capability check or frame error boundary exists.
fix: Report the original cause, stop the failed loop, and show a reload action without resetting progress.
limitations: Missing Canvas is fault-injected; actual GPU/context-loss and device recovery were not forced.

title: Missing ResizeObserver prevents startup
gameplay_impact: Missing ResizeObserver prevents startup
reproduction: Launch in a runtime without ResizeObserver.
expected: Start with a resize-event fallback.
actual: ReferenceError occurs during initialization.
root_cause: ResizeObserver is constructed unconditionally.
fix: Feature-detect the observer and retain window resize handling.
limitations: Verification is limited to the scenarios and environment described below.

title: Initial collision correction allocates excessively in hot paths
gameplay_impact: Initial collision correction allocates excessively in hot paths
reproduction: Profile 30 seeded missions after the first collision correction.
expected: Retain collision correctness with bounded per-step allocation.
actual: Initial corrected p95 step time is 0.108ms versus a 0.028ms baseline.
root_cause: CPU samples point to movement, segment queries, object spreads and garbage collection.
fix: Use scalar slab math, avoid temporary axis arrays/shape spreads, and iterate a stable entity-count snapshot without copying the array.
limitations: Final p95 is 0.035ms on this machine; the corrected solver still does more work than the less-correct baseline. No universal FPS or GPU claim is made.
